fullDescription: A Gen-Z and Millennial-focused LMS (Learning Management System) discovery platform featuring a 'Learning Playground' aesthetic. It utilizes a crisp blue-centric color palette (Blue/Cyan/Slate), clean 'Inter' typography, and a conversational, high-energy tone. The layout is a hybrid of a modern SaaS dashboard and an editorial course marketplace, featuring horizontal carousels, bento-style management cards, and a sleek dark mode. Key features include glassmorphism-inspired background textures, animated navigation underlines, and progress-tracking widgets. Ideal for EdTech, fintech onboarding, or developer documentation portals.
prompt:
## Resumo
A modern, trendy LMS discovery interface with a 'Learning Playground' vibe. The design uses high-contrast typography, soft rounded corners (12px-24px), and a vibrant blue accent system. It features a conversational UI with sections for course discovery, project shipping (gallery), and crew management, all wrapped in a sleek, responsive shell that transitions seamlessly between light and dark modes.

## Estilo Visual
Create a design system using the Inter font family. Light mode palette: Background #FFFFFF, Surface #F8FAFC, Text #1E293B, Muted #64748B, Border #E2E8F0, Accent #2563EB. Dark mode palette: Background #0F172A, Surface #1E293B, Text #F1F5F9, Muted #94A3B8, Border #334155, Accent #3B82F6. Use a base border-radius of 12px (xl) for buttons/inputs and 16px-24px (2xl/3xl) for cards and containers. Implement a 1px solid border strategy for all interactive elements. Navigation links should have a 2px blue underline that scales from 0 to 1 on hover (transform-origin: left). Buttons should have a hover transition of brightness-110 and a subtle shadow-md. Backgrounds should feature large, low-opacity radial gradients at the corners: primary accent at the top-left (10% opacity) and secondary accent at the bottom-right (6% opacity). Add a noise texture overlay at 6% opacity using a fractalNoise SVG filter.

## Layout e Estrutura

### Header and Sticky Navigation
Build a fixed header (height: 64px) with a 1px border-bottom. Left: Logo with a 36px square rounded-xl icon container. Right: Theme toggle button (32px square icon inside a 40px rounded-xl border) and a 'Join Now' high-contrast button. Below the header, include a secondary sticky navbar (height: 56px) with navigation links ('Home', 'Manage Crew', 'The Toolkit') and a large search input (width: 420px) with a left-aligned magnifying glass icon and a 'Filters' button.

### Hero Welcome Section
Create a grid-based hero section (12 columns). Left (7 cols): A 'Curated just for you' pill badge, followed by a level-1 heading 'Welcome back, [Name]' with a blue accent on the name. Include a sub-heading and two primary CTA buttons ('Discover what's next' and 'Jump back in'). Below the buttons, place a wrap-around row of rounded-full category pills (e.g., 'Web Development', 'UI/UX'). Right (5 cols): A 'Continue Learning' card with a 58% width progress bar, a 'Resume' button, and a 'Next Up' calendar event footer.

### Featured Course Carousel
Design a horizontal scrolling section titled 'The hottest right now'. Each card (width: 360px) should have a 144px height icon area with a light grey background, a 'New' or 'Popular' badge in the top right, a bold heading, instructor subtext, and a footer containing duration/level icons and a primary 'Get Started' button.

### Bento Management and Resources
A grid layout featuring multiple management blocks. Include a 'Manage Crew' section with 3 stat-cards (Active, New, Pending), a 'Join the Movement' registration form with 11px height inputs and a select dropdown, an 'E-Resources' toolkit with download buttons, and a 'Gallery' showcasing a 3-column square grid of project thumbnails.

### Global Footer
A 5-column layout on a soft surface background. Column 1: Logo, tagline, and square-xl social media icons (Twitter, LinkedIn, YouTube). Columns 2-5: Link groups for 'About', 'Courses', 'Resources', and 'Contact'. Bottom bar: Copyright text and a horizontal list of 'Terms', 'Privacy', and 'Cookies' with 12px font size.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Progress Widget Card — A high-fidelity progress tracker card with integrated action buttons.
Card container: 16px padding, 24px rounded corners. Progress bar: 8px height, rounded-full, background #E2E8F0, fill #2563EB. Top section: Title and subtitle aligned left, 48px square rounded-2xl icon aligned right. Footer section: Separated by a 1px top border, featuring a calendar icon, time/date info, and a 'Ping me' bell icon button.

### Animated Nav Link — Navigation link with a progressive underline effect.
Text: 14px font size, semi-bold. Interaction: On hover, an absolute positioned 2px height span at bottom: -10px should expand from scaleX(0) to scaleX(1) using a 0.2s ease transition. Use transform-origin: left to ensure it grows from the start of the word.

### Interactive Category Pill — Rounded filter buttons for topic selection.
Height: 36px. Padding: 12px horizontal. Border-radius: 9999px. Border: 1px solid #E2E8F0. Background: #FFFFFF (Light) / #171C2B (Dark). Text: 14px medium. Hover: Background color shifts to #F8FAFC with a 0.2s transition.

## Notas Especiais
MUST use trendy, high-energy copywriting (e.g., 'Ship projects', 'No BS', 'Crush it'). MUST NOT use formal academic language like 'Enrollment' or 'Syllabus' without a casual modifier. DO ensure all interactive elements have a focus-visible ring of 2px for accessibility. MAINTAIN high contrast for typography in dark mode by using Slate-100/200 against a Navy-900 background.

Backgrounds are enhanced with subtle radial gradients (opacity 6-20%) and a fine noise texture for depth.
